original_task_contract.title: Qualify standalone opaque failed-artifact retention
original_task_contract.goal: Implement and independently review a standalone, exact-scope lossless opaque retention/integrity operation for the failed FFF84 pair, without granting semantic qualification, changing the parent agent-corpus gates or authorizing live data mutation.
deliverables: Disjoint tools/forensic_retention_v1 implementation and tools/tests/test_forensic_retention_v1.py, with a standalone versioned M01.17 task/component admission and fail-closed lifecycle.
Exact-scope FFF84 manifest/opaque map/read grammar, full byte/metadata conservation and durable mapping/audit-before-unlink controls, bounded diagnostics and interruption evidence.
Explicit provenance and independently reviewed incoming code closure for any pinned M01.08 primitives; existing parent source, authors, failed runs and review histories remain preserved.
validation: Run deterministic positive/negative controls for source/task/owner/image/approval/closed-writer identity, aliases, partial write/fsync/map/unlink interruption, all-member/range integrity, logical accounting and every byte/node/read/metadata/deadline cap.

Prove standalone admission cannot call M01.08 author admission, override a task identity or let default TaskStore run/resume/cleanup mis-handle an active or interrupted forensic lifecycle; no edits to parent-owned shared adapters.

Qualify exact-source synthetic operation and ordinary inherited checks on native x86_64/ARM64 with no required skips; obtain both distinct nonauthor review roles within this genuine unit's counted history and all required exact-head CI/ci-ok before acceptance.

Qualified-source, root/owner-authorized bounded read-only inventory and dry-run preparation may prepare the content-bound manifest before mutation authorization, under closed/dead-writer, source and identity checks. This grants no shared-state write, actual pack/map, probe/worker, unlink or operation authority. Keep live mutating retention and runtime disabled until the concrete manifest/source/review/resource/integrity gates, root disposition and fresh exact84 human authorization exist.
definition_of_done: Only the exact failed pair can be selected; every byte and recorded metadata field remains reachable through a verified opaque mapping, and candidate/CLI1 bytes cannot become successful original-job Readers or current qualification proof.

Source and failure-state graphs have complete bounded allocation/I/O/node/output/metadata/deadline proofs and independent seeded fault controls; normal 4096/64MiB, 42-node qualification reserve and operation raw8KiB/public16KiB ceilings are preserved.

The final source artifact, its explicit imported primitive closure and claims have complete exact-head checks, two eligible independent roles and normal protected integration. Source acceptance and bounded read-only preparation are distinct from any later live mutating local retained-artifact operation; no unrun operation is claimed complete.

M01.08 full51/oracle/pretrial/trial/token/recovery/native/coverage/CI/product boundaries, old PAIRS/AUTH/older229 current-qualified-native gate, new15 and all historical failures/authors/issued rounds are unchanged.
